definitions.gloss: dosage; dose; amount to be taken
definitions.explanation: the specified amount of medicine to be taken at one time or over a period, as directed by a doctor or indicated on medication packaging

examples.japanese: {服用量|ふくようりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}って→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{服用量|ふくようりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なります→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The dosage varies depending on age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{服用量|ふくようりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Changing the dosage without a doctor's instructions may cause side effects.

notes:
Combines ⟦{服用|ふくよう}→服用：15267_fukuyou⟧ (taking medicine) and ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (amount). A practical term encountered on medicine labels, in pharmacy consultations, and at doctor visits. Understanding dosage instructions is important for daily life in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{服用量|ふくようりょう}: daily dosage
- {服用量|ふくようりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to follow the dosage
- {服用量|ふくようりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧: to increase the dosage
- {服用量|ふくようりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧: to reduce the dosage
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{服用量|ふくようりょう}: maximum dosage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{用量|ようりょう}→用量：18412_youryou⟧: dose; dosage — a shorter, more general term
- ⟦{投与量|とうよりょう}→投与量：26485_touyoryou⟧: administered dose — used by medical professionals for doses given to patients
- ⟦{適量|てきりょう}→適量：14383_tekiryou⟧: appropriate amount — a general term, not specific to medicine
